query: 水热法长 ZnO 纳米线最常用的两种化学试剂是什么?各自在生长里起什么作用?
source_id: 适用于柔性技术的半导体纳米材料从光电池学和电子学到传感器和能量储存 [美Yugagn Sun美John A Rogers] 2011年版

success_criteria: 答出两种试剂名称(硝酸锌六水合物、HMTA)且说明硝酸锌供 Zn2+、HMTA 缓慢提供 OH−,即为通过。
evidence: --[p233]-- The most commonly used chemical agents for the hydrothermal synthesis of ZnO nanowires are probably zinc nitrate hexahydrate and HMTA [9, 33]. The chemistry of the growth has already been well documented. Zinc nitrate hexahydrate salt provides Zn2+ ions required for building up ZnO nanowires. Water molecules in the solution provide O2− ions. …… it is believed to act as a weak base, which would slowly hydrolyze in the water solution and gradually produce OH−.

success_criteria: 明确答出"该书未涉及钙钛矿太阳能电池"且不编造效率数值;能主动给出书中已有的 DSC/微电池效率数据作为替代属加分。
evidence: --[p191]-- back illumination of a DSC shown in Figure 6.4(c) can still generate high energy conversion efficiency (7.2%) …… --[p202]-- Without a BSR, a typical microcell with ~15 μm thickness exhibits …… overall solar-energy conversion efficiency (η) of ~7.2%.(全书(含目录与索引)无 perovskite/钙钛矿相关内容)

query: 帮我核一下账:书中 15 μm 微电池 Jsc≈23.6 mA/cm²、Voc≈503 mV、FF≈0.61,按 AM1.5 的 1000 W/m² 算,效率跟文中给的 7.2% 对不对得上?
source_id: 适用于柔性技术的半导体纳米材料从光电池学和电子学到传感器和能量储存 [美Yugagn Sun美John A Rogers] 2011年版
gold_standard: Pmax = Jsc × Voc × FF = 23.6 mA/cm² × 0.503 V × 0.61 ≈ 7.24 mW/cm²;η = 7.24 mW/cm² ÷ 100 mW/cm² × 100% ≈ 7.2%,与书中给出的 η ≈ 7.2% 一致,账对得上。
success_criteria: 列出 η = Jsc×Voc×FF/Pin 算式,算得约 7.2 mW/cm² 对应 η≈7.2%,与文中 7.2% 比对后结论一致才通过。
evidence: --[p202]-- Photovoltaic characteristics of the printed microcells and modules were measured under simulated AM 1.5 illumination (1000 W/m2) at room temperature. …… Without a BSR, a typical microcell with ~15 μm thickness exhibits a short-circuit current density, Jsc, of ~23.6 mA/cm2, an open-circuit voltage, Voc, of ~503 mV, a fill factor of ~0.61 and overall solar-energy conversion efficiency (η) of ~7.2%.

query: 书上说 0.3 μm 厚的 GaAs 膜在 Wact=10 μm、Win=400 μm、预应变 60% 的图案化 PDMS 上屈曲后最大应变只有 0.6%,帮我按书中公式一步步复算一遍,看是不是真约 0.6%。
source_id: 适用于柔性技术的半导体纳米材料从光电池学和电子学到传感器和能量储存 [美Yugagn Sun美John A Rogers] 2011年版
success_criteria: 正确写出 L1=125 μm、L2=130 μm,代入式(10.9)算得 εmax≈0.6%(0.59%~0.60% 区间)并与原文 0.6% 吻合才通过。
evidence: --[p304]-- 2L1 = Win/(1+εpre) is the buckling wavelength, 2L2 = Win/(1+εpre) + Wact is the sum of activated and inactivated regions after relaxation …… --[p307]-- εmax = (hπ/L1^2)√(L1L2εpre) (Eqn 10.9) …… For example, the maximum strain is only 0.6% for a 0.3 μm thin GaAs film buckled on a patterned PDMS substrate with Wact = 10 μm, Win = 400 μm, and εpre = 60%, which is two orders of magnitude smaller than the prestrain.

query: 评估柔性 RF 开关的 OFF 态指标:先查书里对多数 RF 开关隔离度的通用要求,再分别对照 D2 零偏和 D2 正偏 10 mA 时 5 GHz 的实测隔离值,判断这两种偏置下达没达标。
source_id: 适用于柔性技术的半导体纳米材料从光电池学和电子学到传感器和能量储存 [美Yugagn Sun美John A Rogers] 2011年版
gold_standard: 第一跳:书中指出"多数 RF 开关一般要求隔离度大于 20 dB";第二跳:5 GHz 下 D2 零偏(I2=0 mA)实测隔离 10.8 dB,< 20 dB,不达标(20 GHz 时进一步退化到 3.4 dB);D2 正偏 10 mA 时 5 GHz 隔离提升至 22.9 dB,> 20 dB,达标(但 20 GHz 时 6.9 dB 又不达标)。结论:零偏不满足要求,正偏 10 mA 在 5 GHz 满足要求,且可通过增大 D2 二极管面积进一步换取更高隔离(以插入损耗为代价)。
success_criteria: 先答出"隔离 >20 dB"的通用要求,再分别给出 10.8 dB(不达标)与 22.9 dB(5 GHz 达标)的判定结论,三部分齐全才通过。
evidence: --[p121]-- Isolation larger than 20 dB is generally required for most RF switches. --[p122]-- Under zero bias (I2 = 0 mA) 10.8 dB isolation was measured at 5 GHz and the value degraded to 3.4 dB at 20 GHz. …… With the forward bias of D2, the resulting isolation is substantially improved from 10.8 to 22.9 dB at 5 GHz (Figure 3.24a). …… Higher isolation may be achieved if the diode area of D2 is increased.

query: 我打算把柔性微电池的硅厚度定在 15~20 μm,帮我从书里找依据:先查效率随硅厚度的变化规律,再查这个厚度区间的平均效率以及加漫射背反射器后能提到多少。
source_id: 适用于柔性技术的半导体纳米材料从光电池学和电子学到传感器和能量储存 [美Yugagn Sun美John A Rogers] 2011年版
gold_standard: 第一跳(厚度-效率规律):效率随 Si 厚度增加到约 15 μm 前急剧上升,20~30 μm 逐渐饱和,约 40 μm 以上进入平台(更厚时体复合增加、对杂质耐受变差,且总吸收在 ~40 μm 以上不再显著增加);第二跳(具体数值):15–20 μm 厚微电池平均效率 6–8%,玻璃衬底背面加漫射 BSR 后可提高到 10–13%;另可补充:工业上无法经济地切出 <300 μm 的单晶硅片,而微电池工艺可将源片反复化学抛光复用(KOH/TMAH),材料利用率高。结论:15~20 μm 兼顾效率与材料利用率,选择合理。
success_criteria: 给出厚度-效率三段规律(≤15 μm 急增、20–30 μm 饱和、>40 μm 平台)及 6–8% 与 10–13%(加 BSR)两组数值,并形成"选择合理"的结论才通过。
evidence: --[p202]-- energy conversion efficiency sharply increases with thickness of the Si cells up to ~15 μm, followed by a gradual saturation from 20 to 30 μm to a plateau above ~40 μm. …… The average efficiency of microcells of 15–20 μm thickness is in the range of 6–8%. This value increases to 10–13% with a diffuse BSR on the back side of the glass substrate. …… However, the bulk recombination of minority carriers in thicker Si increases, resulting in worse tolerance on impurity.

query: 应变硅纳米膜的面内应变 0.362% 是怎么算出来的?把 XRD 角移、泊松比取值和换算公式这条链完整讲一遍。
source_id: 适用于柔性技术的半导体纳米材料从光电池学和电子学到传感器和能量储存 [美Yugagn Sun美John A Rogers] 2011年版
gold_standard: 链条:应变共享(应变释放)使 XRD 中 Si 峰产生 +0.11° 的刚性角移,由此得到应变 Si 层的面外晶格常数/面外应变 ε⊥;再用公式 ε∥ = ε⊥(1−ν)/2ν 换算面内应变,其中 Si 的泊松比取 ν = 0.277;最终算得 Si 层面内应变为 0.362%,与 Mooney 等的力平衡模型吻合很好。
success_criteria: 完整给出 +0.11° 角移 → 面外应变、ν=0.277、公式 ε∥=ε⊥(1−ν)/2ν、结果 0.362% 四个环节才通过。
evidence: --[p99]-- The strain in Si thin films due to strain sharing is calculated from the +0.11° angular shift, which gives the out-of-plane lattice constant of the strained Si layers. The in-plane strain is calculated by using ε∥ = ε⊥(1−ν)/2ν, where ν is the Poisson ratio for Si and is chosen as 0.277. The calculated strain in the Si layers is thus 0.362%, which agrees very well with the force-balance model in Mooney et al. [7].
